query:
SELECT 
  rating,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE isApproved = 1), 1) as percentage
FROM reviews 
WHERE isApproved = 1
GROUP BY rating
ORDER BY rating DESC;
